/*
 * 中国联通开屏倒计时净化 Test V2（独立文件名，避免旧版缓存）
 *
 * V1 的 accountListData 本地应答已经命中，但最新 HAR 显示：
 * getclientconfig.htm 在收到服务器响应前被客户端 CANCEL，
 * 因而 V1 的 response 脚本根本没有机会修改 adMaxTime/startMaxTime。
 *
 * V2 对当前实抓版本 iphone_c@12.1400 使用请求阶段本地应答：
 * - 完整保留 HAR 中的原始配置结构；
 * - 只把 adMaxTime=5、startMaxTime=3 改为 0；
 * - 无需等待服务器响应。
 *
 * 其他版本不会使用固定快照，仍走服务器并由 response 模式做同字段兜底，
 * 避免将旧配置长期套到未来版本。
 */

(function () {
  const url = ($request && $request.url) || "";

  if (
    !/^https?:\/\/m\.client\.10010\.com\/mobileService\/customer\/getclientconfig\.htm(?:\?|$)/i.test(
      url
    )
  ) {
    $done({});
    return;
  }

  const SNAPSHOT_12_1400_BASE64 =
    "";

  function base64ToBytes(input) {
    const alphabet =
      "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    const out = [];
    let acc = 0;
    let bits = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
      const ch = input[i];
      if (ch === "=") break;

      const value = alphabet.indexOf(ch);
      if (value < 0) continue;

      acc = (acc << 6) | value;
      bits += 6;

      if (bits >= 8) {
        bits -= 8;
        out.push((acc >> bits) & 0xff);
        acc &= bits === 0 ? 0 : (1 << bits) - 1;
      }
    }

    return new Uint8Array(out);
  }

  // Request mode: current captured client version gets an immediate valid config.
  if (typeof $response === "undefined") {
    const isCapturedVersion =
      /(?:\?|&)version=iphone_c(?:@|%40)12\.1400(?:&|$)/i.test(url);

    if (!isCapturedVersion) {
      $done({});
      return;
    }

    try {
      console.log(
        "ChinaUnicom V2 served immediate 12.1400 no-countdown config"
      );

      $done({
        response: {
          status: 200,
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            "Cache-Control": "no-store"
          },
          body: base64ToBytes(SNAPSHOT_12_1400_BASE64)
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.log("ChinaUnicom V2 request mock error: " + e);
      $done({});
    }

    return;
  }

  // Response mode: future/other versions keep live config and patch only two fields.
  try {
    const body = $response && $response.body;

    if (typeof body !== "string" || body.length === 0) {
      $done({});
      return;
    }

    const outer = JSON.parse(body);
    const dtoWasString = typeof outer.DTO === "string";
    const dto = dtoWasString ? JSON.parse(outer.DTO) : outer.DTO;

    if (!dto || typeof dto !== "object") {
      $done({});
      return;
    }

    const changed = [];

    function setField(name, value) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(dto, name)) return;

      if (String(dto[name]) !== String(value)) {
        changed.push(name + ":" + String(dto[name]) + "->" + String(value));
        dto[name] = value;
      }
    }

    setField("adMaxTime", "0");
    setField("startMaxTime", "0");

    if (changed.length === 0) {
      $done({});
      return;
    }

    outer.DTO = dtoWasString ? JSON.stringify(dto) : dto;

    console.log(
      "ChinaUnicom V2 response countdown neutralized: " + changed.join(", ")
    );

    $done({ body: JSON.stringify(outer) });
  } catch (e) {
    console.log("ChinaUnicom V2 response error: " + e);
    $done({});
  }
})();
